name: BattlePad
description: A controller-first battle UI. The d-pad fires the four moves, the face buttons are FIGHT / RUN / POKEMON / PACK, both sticks drive radial menus, the next action queues while the foe is still attacking, and the battle's menus, bag, party screen and text box wear a modern skin. Button glyphs match the pad in your hands: Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo.
